properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued July 9 at 12:30AM CDT by NWS North Platte NE
properties.description:
At 1229 AM CDT/1129 PM MDT/, Doppler radar was tracking strong
thunderstorms along a line extending from near Roscoe to 11 miles
southwest of Grant. Movement was east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Ogallala, Grant, Madrid, Elsie, Grainton, Wild Horse Spring, and
Brandon.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 61 between mile markers 50 and 86.
Interstate 80 in Nebraska between mile markers 121 and 127, and
between mile markers 137 and 146.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 8 at 8:31PM CDT until July 9 at 10:30PM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Iowa...

Iowa River at Marengo affecting Iowa and Benton Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Iowa River at Marengo.

* WHEN...From late tonight to late tomorrow evening.

* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, Water reaches the bottom of the levee
surrounding Marengo. Water affects low lying agricultural land
along the river

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 PM CDT Wednesday the stage was 14.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
late tonight to a crest of 15.1 feet tomorrow morning. It
will then fall below flood stage early tomorrow afternoon.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

cars through flooded areas.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 8 at 8:30PM CDT until July 9 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS La Crosse WI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small streams flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southern Mower County in southeastern Minnesota...

* WHEN...Until 700 AM CDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads remain closed due to flooding. Expect many
areas of slow moving or standing water to persist into the
overnight hours. It will take several hours for all the water from
these storms to work through local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 825 PM CDT, local law enforcement reports numerous city
streets are flooded and closed. Interstate 90 at 11th drive is
closed. Flooding is ongoing. Between 4.5 and 7 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Austin, Adams, Rose Creek, Dexter, Mapleview, Elkton, County
Roads 56 And 5, Varco and Riverbend Campground.
- This includes Interstate 90 in Minnesota between mile markers 175
and 194.

Wilkinson Counties.

Mary Road is under water.
